rules.label: Pages and people you don't follow

verified: 2026-09-24 live DOM, logged-in home feed, English UI, 51 posts scrolled. Right rail: the 'Sponsored' section is an h3 plus ad cards, each an a[aria-label=Advertiser] linking out through l.facebook.com; the smallest div holding both is the module. Feed: a 'Suggested for you' groups carousel carries that exact aria-label. No sponsored feed post appeared in 51 posts, so the feed ad markers (attributionsrc privacy_sandbox, /ads/about, aria-labelledby resolving to 'Sponsored') are still from known markup, not seen live. Timestamps' aria-labelledby resolve to e.g. '6 hours ago'. Dutch UI strings unchecked. Suggested (live 2026-09-24, English UI): a post from a group you are not in has a role=button reading exactly 'Join' inside the profile_name header; a page you do not follow, 'Follow' in the same place. The 'Reels' module is a feed unit headed by an h3 reading 'Reels'. 'Your group suggestions' is a feed unit whose cards carry aria-label 'Join group'. Dutch, German and French strings are baseline guesses, UNVERIFIED live.
